The `crap` check fails on head `980ac31a` (ci_failures.md):

```
NEW > 8  js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js::walk: 15
0 regression(s), 1 new over threshold, 0 improvement(s), 0 removed
##[error]Process completed with exit code 2.
```

The new `v1ShimIndex()` helper (test_instructionRefs.js:200) inlines one `walk` closure carrying all of the branch work: the `file_list` shape normalization, dotfile skip, the `file_exists` dual-shape dir test (`ex === true || (ex && typeof ex === 'object' && ex.exists === true)`), the `.md`/dir fork, the banner cut ternary, the missing-banner `continue`, and the `livePat` exec loop — CC lands the function over the CRAP 8 threshold at its measured coverage.

Fix per the repo's CRAP-split convention: extract small pure helpers — e.g. `isDirEntry(ex)`, `shimBannerPaths(txt)` (returns the live paths named by a banner), and a per-entry step — and pin each with direct unit tests, or extend R13's fixtures so `walk`'s branches run under the coverage harness. Either way the ratchet must go green; everything else in this PR is already green (unit suite 10807 passed, 0 failed).

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: validator resolves skill-file `lens` paths against the wrong root — false-fails on the documented consuming-repo layout**

`scripts/validate-review-skills.js` resolves **every** path through `toRepoRelative` (`path.join(repoRoot, p)`, lines 112–131), but the factory skill files' `lens` field carries a **pack-relative** path (`"instructions/pr_review/generalist/lens.md"`). In this checkout the two roots coincide, so the CI step passes — but the script's own documented usage is the consuming repo ("from the consuming repo root, with the agents pack available", header; `factoryDirs` even defaults to `agents/instructions/review`, line 90). With the pack at `agents/`, `readFile` looks for `<repoRoot>/instructions/pr_review/generalist/lens.md` while the file lives at `<repoRoot>/agents/instructions/...` — the read misses, and the check-3 split (lines 162–169) promotes "lens file missing or empty" from warning to **hard error → exit 1**.

Reproduced against a product-repo layout (`agents/` → this pack + a `.dmtools/config.js` carrying `reviewPolicy.required`):

```
✅ reviewer "base" (factory) — lens instructions/pr_review/generalist/lens.md | required:true | ...
❌ base: lens file missing or empty: instructions/pr_review/generalist/lens.md
❌ security: lens file missing or empty: instructions/pr_review/security/lens.md
reviewer pool: 2 reviewer(s) validated · 2 error(s), 0 warning(s)
❌ validate-review-skills: FAILED        # exit 1 — lenses exist; unfixable via --factory/--repo flags
```

Suggested fix: resolve factory-owned paths (lens, and any skill file path) against the discovered `packRoot` (fall back repoRoot-relative for repo-authored `.dmtools/review` paths — those are genuinely repo-root-relative, e.g. the valid fixture's `.dmtools/review/legal.lens.md`). A repo-vs-pack discriminator at the `io` bag keeps the pure `resolvePool` contract unchanged and lets a downstream repo actually use its §8 gate.

comments.author: ajaxspace
comments.body:
Owner-directed changes pushed on top (2 commits, no scope creep — the execution layer stays in the follow-up):

**1. `30fe8166e` — owner revision: merge gating via `reviewPolicy.required` (replaces the per-reviewer `isRequired` field).**
- Skill-file schema drops `isRequired` (issue #1406 revised accordingly: §2/§3/§7/§8/§10 + a revision note at the top). A stale `isRequired` in any skill file now WARNS with the migration hint; a same-name tuning file still hard-errors (extend-never-replace) with the same hint.
- `reviewPolicy` gains the `required` key (factory default `['base','security']`, repo-owned; `required: []` gates nothing — "merge rules are repo rules" in ONE place).
- Explicit unknown required name = hard error (§8 check 8: a misspelled gate silently gates nothing). The factory DEFAULT list degrades to a WARNING for reviewers that did not load — keeps the `resolvePool` fail-soft contract (io-failure edge suites stay green).
- Required-but-disabled reviewer = warning (it never runs, so it cannot gate).
- PR-facing prose cleaned: the merge-gate hold line, PASS/pool/escalation marker texts and the quality.yml step name no longer carry issue ids (repo norm: issue refs live in comments; `test_mergeGate` now pins the generic invariant AND the absence of issue ids in runtime strings).

**2. `2c70d0158` — frozen v1 instruction shims (backward compat for downstream repos pinning old paths).**
- All 7 pre-split paths restored under `instructions/pr_review/` + `instructions/pr_test_automation_review/`: 3 renames carry the live v2 content verbatim (byte-sync test S3), 4 deleted/split files carry their pre-split content verbatim from history. Every shim opens with a DEPRECATED banner (removed next major). Full copies, not stubs — these files are prompt material for AI teammates with file-scope reads.
- Pack reachability: shims are packed via the new hub `instructions/pr_review/deprecated-v1.md`, anchored by one comment line in `base/input_context.md` (instructionRefs R1–R4 green).
- `validate-review-skills.js` warns when a repo config or `.dmtools/runners/*.json` still pins a v1 path (names the live replacement). Also carries §8 check 8.

Full node harness on this head: `10767 passed, 4 failed` — the 4 are shell self-tests from gh-1137/gh-1450 (`setup/dart.sh`, `gh-auth-refresh.sh`, `gh-token-keeper.sh`), pre-existing macOS-local noise; the same head family is green on ubuntu CI. Regenerated docs/snapshots are committed.

comments.author: dmtools-factory-bot[bot]
comments.body:
### Thread 1 — owner-directed changes on top (30fe8166e, 2c70d0158)

Both owner-directed commits are verified ancestors of the current head (`d55e5fa6b` — `git merge-base --is-ancestor` green for `30fe8166e` and `2c70d0158`). No re-litigation of their content; this lap picked up the one red they left behind:

**`teammate / teammate` job red on `d55e5fa6` — fixed in `980ac31a9`.**

- **Cause**: `2c70d0158`'s split moved `review_verdict_rules.md` into `instructions/pr_review/base/`, and the runner `.dmtools/runners/fa-review.json` was re-pinned to `pack:instructions/pr_review/base/review_verdict_rules.md` in the same PR. Packs are cut from the base branch, so every released pack (`pr_review-0.1.337` from `agents-rel-20261112-203940` — verified by unzipping the release asset) still ships only the pre-split paths. The review leg crashed at setup: `AgentPackException: pack: reference ... not found in pack` — the PR could not go green regardless of content.
- **Fix**: the runner pin now rides the frozen v1 shim (`pack:instructions/pr_review/review_verdict_rules.md`) — same binding content (the shim carries the v2 body verbatim plus a 4-line deprecation banner) and it resolves in today's released pack **and** in every post-merge pack (the shims are pack-reachable per the hub anchor). The flip to the v2 path is a one-line follow-up once a pack release carries it; `validate-review-skills.js` emits its designed migration warning meanwhile (`⚠️ runner ... pins the deprecated v1 path ... — moved to ...`; exit 0, non-fatal).
- **Regression guard**: `R13` in `test_instructionRefs.js` — every runner `pack:` ref must exist on disk and must never pin a moved target while its frozen v1 shim is still on disk. It fails on the pre-fix tree with the exact violation and is green on the fixed tree; registered in `run_all.json` (CI coverage step) and verified under the full node harness: **10807 passed, 0 failed**.

Scope guard: `instructions/pr_review/security/{lens,few_shots,references}.md` are currently unreachable from any base config (so unpacked until then) — that wiring belongs to the pool execution layer that moved to the follow-up, so it was deliberately not touched here.

comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: One blocking CI break (CRAP ratchet red on `test_instructionRefs.js::walk`, quality job exit 2) and one important validator defect (factory `lens` paths resolved repoRoot-relative → false "lens file missing" exit 1 on the documented consuming-repo layout, reproduced) must be fixed. The pool core itself is solid: schema/validation are strict where the ticket demands it, the merge gate's pool clause is fail-closed on machine-identity trust with the 429 scenario, dedup, escalation and capability-miss paths all pinned by tests, and no secrets or issue-id strings leak into PR-facing runtime text.

**Key Issues**:
1. 🚨 `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:202` — CI `crap` gate red: `NEW > 8 test_instructionRefs.js::walk: 15` → quality job exit 2.
2. ⚠️ `scripts/validate-review-skills.js:117` — skill-file `lens` paths are pack-relative but `io.readFile` resolves repoRoot-relative; downstream repos with the pack at `agents/` get a red gate the flags cannot fix (verified: exit 1 with both factory lenses "missing").

**Ranked digest** (post top-K cap not needed — no 💡/🪶 threads; these are the overflow):
- `js/common/reviewPool.js:36` — `disabledRequiredNames(probe)` recomputed twice per loop iteration; hoist to a local.
- `js/common/reviewPoolSchema.js:471` — `validateRequiredList` validates a reviewPolicy key but throws the ReviewSkillValidationError family (header taxonomy says policy keys → ReviewPolicyValidationError); nothing branches on the name today — consistency only.
- `instructions/pr_review/review_verdict_rules.md:2-4` (all 7 shims) — banner lines open `<!--` without closing `-->`; HTML rendering swallows the heading + first flowchart up to the first `-->`. Raw-text consumers (the agents) are unaffected.
- `js/common/reviewPoolMarkers.js:121` — marker prose reads "Reviewer pool round \`X\` pool round on head" (duplicated phrase).
- `scripts/validate-review-skills.js:62-69` — `parseArgs` treats any unknown flag as the positional repoRoot.
- `test_buildEncodedConfig.js` / `test_writeSolutionAndLabels.js` — DEFAULT_TRACKER `java` shim copy-pasted across suites (duplication gate measured and accepted; candidate for a shared helper).

**Next Steps**:
1. CRAP-split `v1ShimIndex`'s `walk` into small tested helpers (or raise its coverage via R13 fixtures) until the ratchet is green.
2. Fix the validator's path roots: factory-owned paths against `packRoot`, repo-authored against `repoRoot`; re-run the node harness + the §8 step.
3. Note: the merge gate now fails CLOSED on a broken comments read (retry-merge lane test updated from fail-open) — deliberate, documented (#1319 parity); no action, called out for release notes.
